SELECT DISTINCT TABLE_ID , TABLE_NAME FROM BOK_TABLELIST WHERE 1 = 1
and ( TABLE_ID like concat_ws('','%',#{likeStr},'%') or TABLE_NAME like concat_ws('','%',#{likeStr},'%') )
order by TABLE_ID

SELECT VOUCH_REMARK as vouchRemark, IFNULL(B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO, B.SUBJECT_NO) AS subjectNo, IFNULL(bbd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NAME, bs.SUBJECT_NAME) AS subjectName, (case when B.CD_FLAG = 'D' then B.B_HAPPEN_AMT else null end) dBHappenAmt, (case when B.CD_FLAG = then B.HAPPEN_AMT else null end) cBHappenAmt, (case when B.CD_FLAG = then B.HAPPEN_AMT else null end) dHappenAmt, (case when B.CD_FLAG = 'C' then B.HAPPEN_AMT else null end) cHappenAmt, B.ccy AS ccy, B.HAPPEN_NUMBER AS happenNumber FROM bok_VOUCH_DETAIL B JOIN bok_VOUCH_MAIN A ON A.VOUCH_NUM = B.VOUCH_NUM LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bb ON BB.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_SUBJECT bs ON bs.BOOKSET_ID = bb.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AND bs.SUBJECT_NO = B.SUBJECT_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BUSS_DETSUB bbd ON bbd.BOOKSET_ID = A.BOOKSET_ID AND bbd.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO = B.DETAIL_SUBJECT_NO WHERE A.BUS_VOUCHNUM = #{busVouchnum} AND A.BOOKSET_ID = #{booksetId}
